incident: Authentication service unavailable after secret format change
symptoms: auth pods start but reject all tokens
issue began immediately after secret rotation
recent_changes: See root-cause context; synthetic historical incident.
root_cause: The signing secret was stored in a new encoded format but the application expected the previous representation.
resolution: A secret format change made the authentication service interpret the signing key incorrectly. Restoring the expected representation recovered token validation.
postmortem: Another rotation would reproduce the same incompatible format.
Restarting pods only reloaded the incompatible secret.
